verdict.line: You win this lane outright if you crack Granite Shield before committing and chain Q into E, but the matchup slips away if it drags past 25 minutes once Malphite finishes his armor items.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's short Q and E cooldowns let him re-engage faster than Malphite's Granite Shield can recharge, which is why Aatrox holds both the lane and solo-kill edge here. But the 45.5% win rate over 3,068 games shows that edge erodes once Malphite's Ground Slam starts hitting harder off stacked armor and he reaches Unstoppable Force at full build, so the lane lead has to be banked early, not played out passively.

theirWindow.what: Don't dump your full combo into a fresh shield. Let him throw Seismic Shard (Q) or walk up first, bait the shield down, then commit.

yourWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance proc and E off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage with Q (The Darkin Blade), land the empowered Deathbringer Stance auto to crack his shield and heal off his max health, then use E (Umbral Dash) to extend or disengage before his Ground Slam resets.

powerCurve.note: His Q poke (8s CD) outranges you before E unlocks
Q/E cooldowns shrink, sustain loop takes over
He has R but it's a cooldown liability 1v1
Armor stacking makes Ground Slam and W spike
Unstoppable Force outscales your takedown-reliant R

start.why: Malphite's entire early kit is chip damage (Seismic Shard poke, Ground Slam) rather than burst, so the passive damage reduction and sustain from Doran's Shield neutralizes his poke plan outright.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the movement speed steal from Seismic Shard short and the magic resist directly answers Ground Slam, which is his only real magic damage source in lane.

core.why: The armor shred is the single best answer to Malphite stacking armor off Brutal Strikes and tank items, and this path hits 69% win rate over 84 games.
Ability haste compounds your Q/E loop, letting you re-engage through Granite Shield's recharge window even more often.
Converts the physical damage he does take from your E passive and empowered autos into longer trades you can survive if he lands Ground Slam.

situational.when: you're already ahead on kills and want a burst/shield spike for all-in windows instead of the slower Spear of Shojin scaling
you want to lean harder into single-target dueling procs off Black Cleaver rather than teamfight ability haste
malphite's team is stacking additional magic damage and you need the shield plus magic resist to keep trading

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off your melee Q hits and auto-attacks during extended trades, and the adaptive force/healing payoff synergizes directly with Umbral Dash's on-hit heal.

summoners.why: Ignite is the higher pick rate (60%) and converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual early kill once you land Q into E; Teleport is the safer choice if you expect his Seismic Shard poke to push you off the wave and you'd rather play for scaling and side-lane resets.

playing.title: Bait before you crack shield
playing.detail: Watch whether Granite Shield has had time to recharge. If it's up, let him throw Seismic Shard or step up first instead of opening with your full combo into a free shield.

playing.title: Q then E through his engage
playing.detail: The instant he closes with Brutal Strikes or walks in to auto, land Q (The Darkin Blade) and use E (Umbral Dash) to dash through him, dealing damage and healing off the Umbral Dash passive.

playing.title: Save Deathbringer Stance for champions
playing.detail: Don't burn the empowered auto on minions. Hold it to break Granite Shield and heal off his max health during a real trade.

playing.title: Chain W onto his disengage
playing.detail: Infernal Chains only damages once on hit, but he has to leave the impact area fast or get dragged back for a second hit. Throw it the moment he tries to walk away after poking.

playing.title: Cut trades short after level 6
playing.detail: Once he's buying armor, Ground Slam's attack speed reduction starts eating into your Deathbringer Stance sustain. Take your Q-E hit and leave instead of standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: Hold R to extend, not to open
playing.detail: World Ender's fear and move speed bonus are best spent finishing a trade you're already winning or chasing after a kill, since his Unstoppable Force punishes you for over-extending into an all-in.

playing.title: Play river carefully post-6
playing.detail: His knockup combos badly with jungle ganks even though you still win the 1v1, so give extra space in brush and river the moment he hits level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG (3,068-game Aatrox vs Malphite sample); the trade timing, cooldown reasoning, and power-curve reading are my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q]-[E] the moment Malphite closes in to use (Q). Use your [P] reinforced basic attack whenever possible to increase your lane sustain.
